**Additional notes on PDP8 coal phase-out:** Vietnam’s PDP8 (2023) commits to a peak coal capacity of about 30.5 GW (excluding canceled projects) and then decline after 2035. Several previously planned coal plants (e.g., Quynh Lap 2, Vung Ang 3–4, Nam Dinh 1, Cong Thanh, etc.) have been suspended or converted to LNG. The table above reflects the status as of early 2024.

**Gas plants using domestic gas** are declining due to depletion. New gas plants will run on imported LNG (e.g., Nhon Trach 3–4, O Mon 3–4, Son My, Tan Phuoc). These are listed under “LNG” but technology remains CCGT.

**Sources (general):**
- Power Development Plan VIII (QĐ 500/QĐ-TTg, 15/5/2023) – [Chính phủ Việt Nam](https://vanban.chinhphu.vn)
- EVN Annual Reports 2022–2023 – [EVN](https://en.evn.com.vn)
- PVN reports – [PetroVietnam](https://www.pvn.vn)
- Vinacomin – [TKV](https://www.vinacomin.vn)
- MOIT statistics – [MOIT](https://moit.gov.vn)
- Various IPP websites (AES, Jaks, Sumitomo, etc.)

*This table is not exhaustive for very small units (<30 MWe) or retired plants not listed in public reports.*

## Goal

Produce a complete, primary-sourced reference inventory of Vietnam's past, present and future thermal generation assets (> 30MWe) structured as follows:

## Structured power plants table

Tabulate for every thermal power plant in Vietnam:

| Name (Vietnamese) | Name (English) | Province | Fuel | Technology | Units × MW | Total MWe | Status | COD | Owner/Developer | Source 1 | Source 2 | Notes |

Where:
- Fuel: Coal / Domestic gas / Imported LNG
- Technology (coal): Subcritical / Supercritical / USC
- Technology (gas): CCGT / OCGT
- Status: Approved / Planned / Operational / Under construction / Suspended / Cancelled / Retired
- Total MWe: Include units > 30MWe.
- COD: Actual or expected commercial operation date
- Sources: specify where in the document, include URL

Output format: Markdown.
